title: AI Incident Analysis Agent
description: Incident analysis system for logs and metrics. It ingests operational data, normalizes it into aligned time windows, detects anomalies, correlates incident candidates, runs deterministic root-cause analysis, and generates structured reports through a provider abstraction.
